scope: Tiny synthetic model-backed field probe API qualification; isolated 0D scaffold only, no native mesh generation or PDE solve
sizing_policy: Reuse frozen edge MathEval/Min/Threshold, inherited effective transition thickness, exact projection oracle and probe tolerances
adapter_policy: Isolated named model with explicit discrete point entity, nodes and type-15 elements; NodeData view; select original model for field lookup; preserve before gates; owned view/model removal and exact original state restoration
repeat_rule: Byte-identical complete report and all payload hashes across two fresh workers, excluding logs/resource telemetry
